## Quick answer


**The official Remaker AI website is remaker.ai; Remaker says it does not have an official mobile app.**


Its browser tools cover photo, video, GIF, batch and multi-face swaps. The[photo face-swap tool](https://remaker.ai/face-swap-free/) advertises no signup and no watermark. The[video face-swap tool](https://remaker.ai/video-face-swap-online/) displays one credit per second and supports uploads up to 500 MB or 30 minutes. Credit packs are one-time purchases, start at $5.99 for 200 credits, and do not expire according to Remaker's current site.


For another browser service in this category, see the[AIFaceSwap.io review](https://magichour.ai/blog/aifaceswapio-review) . Compare the exact photo or video workflow and its export allowance; similar service names do not imply shared accounts or credits.

## **What Is Remaker AI?**


[Remaker AI](http://remaker.ai/) is a browser-based AI editing platform that offers[face swapping](https://magichour.ai/products/face-swap) ,[AI image generation](https://magichour.ai/products/ai-image-generator) , background removal, image upscaling, AI headshots, and dozens of other creative tools.


The platform is operated by **ZINGDECK INTL PTE. LTD.** , a Singapore-based company. Instead of charging a monthly subscription, it uses a **pay-as-you-go credit system** , so you only purchase credits when needed.


Everything runs in the browser, making it accessible on both desktop and mobile devices without downloading software.


## Which official Remaker site should you use?


Start at[remaker.ai](https://remaker.ai/) for the service reviewed here. Remaker's[official app notice](https://remaker.ai/official-remaker-ai-app/) says it does not currently offer an official app and warns against similarly named App Store or Google Play listings. Use the browser site and do not assume that another app's login, purchases, privacy terms or developer belong to Remaker AI.


Before paying, match the developer, support destination, account, and billing terms to the service you intended to use. A third-party page displaying “Remaker AI” does not establish an official Remaker model or shared credits.

## **How Remaker AI Face Swap Works**


### 1. Open the appropriate Remaker tool


For a still image, go directly to[Remaker Photo Face Swap](https://remaker.ai/face-swap-free/) , which currently advertises no-signup, watermark-free access. For a moving clip, open[Video Face Swap](https://remaker.ai/video-face-swap-online/) ; its FAQ says purchasing credits unlocks VIP video access. Account signup offers are separate from those tool-specific rules. Screenshots below show an earlier account interface.


### **2. Open the Face Swap tool**


Choose the mode for your file: a single photo, multiple faces, video/GIF or batch processing. Use the current tool labels and generation quote rather than assuming every captured menu is unchanged.


### **3. Upload your photos**


In the current photo tool, upload the **Original Image** first: the scene whose face you want to replace. Then upload the **Target face** : the portrait supplying the new face. Read the helper text beneath each input; other services sometimes use “source” and “target” in the opposite order.


Remaker automatically detects facial landmarks before processing.


### 4. Check the available model and generation quote


The earlier interface screenshot shows V1 and V2 options. Those labels describe that captured version of the tool, not a guarantee about the controls currently available to every account.


If a model selector is available, compare a representative input before processing a large batch. The older V1/V2 labels alone do not establish which model will preserve your subject better.


### **5. Generate and download**


Click **Swap** and wait for processing to finish.


Inspect the actual download for a watermark and check the export conditions for your chosen tool. Photo and video offers can differ.

**Worked example:** at the video tool’s displayed rate of **one credit per second** , one thirty-second attempt uses **30 credits** . ## **Where Remaker AI Face Swap Falls Short**


- **Free access needs an account-specific check.** Confirm the balance, expiry, tool eligibility, and download restrictions shown to you.
- **A credit pack is not a fixed number of finished videos.** Duration, settings, and repeated attempts affect usage.
- **A completed swap still needs review.** Watch turns, expressions, and obstructions before paying to process a longer version.

## **Best Alternatives to Remaker AI Face Swap**


Disclosure: Magic Hour publishes this guide and also offers face-swap tools. The Remaker facts above link to Remaker’s own pages; compare both services with the same permitted source file, required output, and current checkout terms.


### **1. Magic Hour**


Best for: trying a photo face swap without installing software or creating an account


[Magic Hour photo face swap](https://magichour.ai/products/face-swap) offers five free swaps per day without signup, with watermark-free photo downloads.[Video face swap](https://magichour.ai/products/face-swap/video) is a separate workflow: free videos include a watermark.

### **2. DeepSwap**

[DeepSwap](https://www.deepswap.ai/) is designed primarily for video face swapping and supports replacing **up to six faces in a single video** , making it a strong choice for group videos, short films, and social media skits.


Compare a short sample containing the expressions and movements in your actual project before committing to a longer export.


[DeepSwap’s published rates](https://www.deepswap.ai/en/pricing) distinguish photos, GIFs and video. Its video rate is one credit per fifteen seconds, but DeepSwap credits and Remaker credits have different purchase prices. Compare the total cost and required export for the same clip.

[Pica AI](https://www.pica-ai.com/face-swap/) supports up to **three faces per photo or video** , with each reference assigned to a different original face. Its video workflow offers GIF or MP4 downloads. Check the current generation and download offer rather than relying on an old fixed daily quota.


## **Does Remaker AI have a face-swap API?**


Yes. Remaker publishes separate API documentation for photo face swap, multiple-face swap, and video face swap. The[photo face-swap API](https://remaker.ai/docs/api/face-swap/) uses an API key, documents a regular-user limit of 20 task submissions per minute, and says generated images are deleted after 24 hours. Confirm current pricing, limits, output retention, retries, and commercial terms for the exact endpoint before building a production workflow.

## Is Remaker AI legitimate and safe to use?


Remaker is an active browser service with an official[website](https://remaker.ai/) , published[terms](https://remaker.ai/en/terms-and-conditions/) , a[privacy policy](https://remaker.ai/en/privacy-and-cookies-policy/) , pricing, and[API documentation](https://remaker.ai/docs/api/) . Those are useful identity and policy checks; they are not the same as an independent security audit or a guarantee that every upload is suitable for sensitive work.


Before uploading a face, read the policy for the exact workflow and avoid material you do not have permission to process. Remaker’s photo API documentation says generated API images are deleted after 24 hours, but that statement applies to that documented endpoint. Do not assume it describes retention for every browser tool, input file, account record, or payment record.


Check purchase terms before buying credits. Remaker’s current terms describe one-time, non-recurring purchases and limit refund eligibility to a first purchase, no more than 50 credits used, and a request within three days. Meeting those conditions does not guarantee approval, so test the relevant mode and export on a low-cost sample first.


## **A Note on Safe and Legal Use**


Use source media and likenesses you have permission to edit and publish. Do not present a manipulated performance as an authentic recording of what someone said or did. Check the disclosure requirements of the platform where you will share it; a tool subscription does not provide rights to third-party footage or people’s likenesses.

## A faster Remaker-to-Magic-Hour migration test


Do not rebuild the entire project first. Export one representative source face and one target that includes the hardest condition in the job: a profile turn, glasses, hair across the face, fast movement, or several people. Run that same pair in both services. Keep framing, duration, and source resolution constant so the comparison measures the workflow rather than different inputs.


**For a photo, judge identity, hairline, jaw, skin tone, and changes outside the face. For video, also inspect every turn, occlusion, cut, and lighting change.** Record attempts, credits consumed, processing time, cleanup time, export conditions, and whether the result is usable. Cost per accepted output is more useful than price per generation.


If the sample passes, move the rest of the project. If it fails, change one input variable before buying more credits. This preserves the parts of the Remaker workflow that already work while testing whether Magic Hour improves the exact deliverable you need.

Run a consented photo or video sample. Review the complete output, then move only the projects that pass your acceptance criteria.
